why: The Astro matrix (docs/v3/verdicts/astro-matrix.md, Issue 2540): CodeBlock and Markdown render their code uncoloured on a static page and Shiki colours it after mount (1 to 5% of pixels differ). Highlighting is presentation: a content site (Issue 2531, Astro) should ship coloured code with no JavaScript and keep an island only for the copy button.
what: Shiki output in the server HTML of CodeBlock and of Markdown fences, the same markup the browser renders after hydration.
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/content/contract.ts unless a prop is added through the contract-amendment path
change: Render the highlighted tokens during the server render (await the highlighter inside the render, for example with Suspense and use()), keep the streaming and untrusted-content paths as they are, and hydrate without a mismatch.
acceptance: The Astro matrix records code-block and markdown static-clean at 1440 and 390, light and dark (make astro-matrix UPDATE=1, the record in the same PR)
An SSR test: renderToString (or the stream) of a CodeBlock contains the highlighted spans and hydrates without a mismatch warning
The untrusted Markdown tests pass unchanged
proof: make astro-matrix UPDATE=1 (the record and its .md change only for the parts above), make check
commits: package changes in their own commit; the matrix record (docs/v3/verdicts/astro-matrix.*) in a non-package commit
